title: Sea the City Jet Ski
specs: Jet ski tours launch from Liberty Landing Marina, Jersey City, 15 minutes from Manhattan
Hot tub boat tours cruise past Statue of Liberty, Brooklyn Bridge, Ellis Island
Jet ski tours include views of Statue of Liberty, Brooklyn Bridge, Manhattan skyline
Hot tub boat tubs heated year-round at 102°F
Hot tub boat: everyone in tub must be 18+, or 10+ if accompanied by parent or guardian
21+ with valid photo ID to drink alcohol on hot tub boat; no hard liquor allowed
Jet ski drivers must be 18+ with valid photo ID
Jet ski passengers can be 10+ with parent or guardian on same ski
Jet ski max combined weight 400 lbs per ski
Hot tub boat: up to 10 per tub, two tubs on boat; full boat buyout up to 20 people
